title: Spring to Fix
description: Minor changes to "Spring to Life" drop
body:
![Requires Polytone and Entity Model Features](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d39ef4d7a04056729fbe59ead42bb642b45f2950.png)

**Requires Polytone and Entity Model Features**

This resource pack aims to improve and expand upon the "Spring to Life" drop content. It will also change the content of other drops in the future.

**Changes:**
- Textures for bushes, tall dry grass, and short dry grass.
- The firefly bushes bottom texture is colored depending on the biome and the fireflies on the texture only appear at night.
- New model for the cactus flower.
- Slightly modified model for the cold cow, warm pig and sheep, and textures for the warm cow and cold pig.
- Removed tinted leaf particles, instead, leaves blocks will now drop unique leaves from every tree except the spruce.
- Dyes sprites

Unfortunately, replacing mob models doesn't work with vanilla backport.
